title: Shirley R NDE 3737
content: Transfusion in the middle of a fourteen hour major kidney surgery that did not work. Experience happened during post-op in my hospital bed, a few hours after surgery. Standing at the light, that is not really a light like we know on earth, I felt I finally was home after a long, long journey. Every question I ever wanted to know about the universe and life was answered at that moment and not a word was spoken, but I could feel the information enter my soul. There were silhouettes of women and men and children floating up at an angle through a fog like light. All were looking up at an angle and I was watching them and waiting for what seemed like my turn. I was filled with happiness, safety, and love, everything we the people look for and seek out here on earth. I still cry to go home into the light, I do not want to be here on earth anymore, but know that I have no choice not even suicide. The whole experience seemed to be over in a second when in fact it lasted hours or days, I really cannot pin point a time, and in fact the whole experience is played over and over in my mind daily, still in 2008.Transfusion in the middle of a fourteen hour major kidney surgery that did not work.
